text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All those days spent raising her overall 
baseline with the goal of becoming a 
Triple Crown Umamusume. Her milestone of 
placing in a GⅠ race was also successfully 
achieved!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For the finishing touch, 
Matikanetannhauser said she wanted to 
undergo one final training session and 
headed for the mountains! Just when one 
might expect brutal, grueling training to 
await—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During waterfall meditation, she was 
gently watched over by experienced 
practitioners; during mountain climbing, 
tonjiru pork soup was handed out midway; 
and during running, she blended into the 
girls' volleyball team...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It ended up being far more laid-back than 
expected, making for a day that truly 
showcased her personality—someone who fits 
right in no matter where she goes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once spring comes, it's finally time for 
the Satsuki Sho! I need to buckle down and 
prepare for it!
